torus4096-baseline.json.scope: Complete resident-device meshing: input topology, optional automatic sizing, fresh initial sampling, progressive growth, global fitting and recovery, optional quality rounds, final extraction and diagnostics. Allocation, compilation, upload and serialization excluded from replay; setup reported separately.

torus4096-baseline-scratch.json.scope:
Measure benchmark-local sharing of transient FP64 clipping storage (#122).

Every constructor keeps its own hierarchy, connectivity, retained fragments,
strategy hints and certificate. The saved clipping cells are only kernel-local
work; the existing builders already overwrite this storage between chunks.
